description: This source file defines the 'Locale' class which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically within the NumberFormat wizard. The class handles locale-based formatting for number representations, including validation and pattern retrieval.

classes.name: Locale
classes.description: A class that encapsulates locale-specific number formatting using PHP's Intl NumberFormatter, including validation of locale strings and retrieval of formatting patterns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Locale object, setting up the NumberFormatter with the specified locale and style, and validating the locale data.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the pattern string used for formatting numbers according to the locale.
